_meta.note: autonomous oscillator on the EXISTING measured EDAR gamma; no new organ, no new fitted constant; additive layer, core battery untouched

alopecia_areata.anchor: AA is immune-mediated premature catagen / anagen arrest with patchy loss and frequent spontaneous or treated regrowth [L]
alopecia_areata.grade_absolute: [O] absolute patch extent / regrowth latency needs per-follicle calibration (appendage target obstacle)
alopecia_areata.grade_shape: [V] anagen-collapse under a sustained drive + regrowth on removal
alopecia_areata.mechanism: sustained immune-type premature-catagen drive forces follicles out of anagen into telogen (patchy synchronized loss); persistent while driven, anagen resumes on removal (regrowth, hysteresis)

anagen_effluvium.anchor: anagen effluvium is rapid shedding of anagen hairs during cytotoxic therapy, distinct from the delayed telogen effluvium, and reverses after the insult [L]
anagen_effluvium.grade_absolute: [O] absolute shed fraction / onset needs per-follicle calibration (appendage target obstacle)
anagen_effluvium.grade_shape: [V] immediate shed (no telogen delay); reversible on removal
anagen_effluvium.mechanism: a direct insult to the anagen matrix (cytotoxic chemotherapy / radiation) sheds anagen hairs immediately, without transit through telogen; reversible when the insult stops

androgenetic_alopecia.anchor: AGA is androgen-driven progressive follicular miniaturisation with anagen shortening; minoxidil/finasteride prolong anagen [L]
androgenetic_alopecia.grade_absolute: [O] absolute hair count / vellus fraction needs per-follicle calibration (appendage target obstacle)
androgenetic_alopecia.mechanism: standing anti-growth (miniaturisation) drive shortens the anagen plateau -> terminal->vellus miniaturisation; pro-growth drive (minoxidil/anti-androgen) lengthens anagen back

telogen_effluvium.anchor: TE is a synchronized premature-telogen entry after a systemic stressor, with a diffuse shed ~3 months (one telogen) later and spontaneous recovery [L]
telogen_effluvium.grade_absolute: [O] absolute shed count / 3-month latency needs an absolute cycle period (appendage target obstacle)
telogen_effluvium.grade_shape: [V] delayed synchronized shed at ~one telogen lag; self-limited
telogen_effluvium.mechanism: a transient systemic stressor synchronously pushes an anagen cohort into telogen; the cohort sheds one telogen duration later (a delayed diffuse shed), then re-enters anagen -> self-limited
